meta.title: feat(editor): implement code splitting and tree shaking optimizations
meta.body_summary: Implement code splitting and tree shaking in the editor package via React.lazy, Suspense, and Vite manual chunks, aiming to reduce bundle size and improve initial load performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added lazy components and Vite chunk splitting with bundle size claims; maintainer blocked due to unnecessary file modifications; partial reverts made but auto-closed after 7+ days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 232 changed lines across 14 files, this is a small-to-medium frontend performance refactor. It fits a moderate incremental optimization PR, but was closed—not merged—because the agent changed files that were outside the intended scope and activity stalled.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer zhyd1997 repeatedly flagged changes to postcss.config.mjs, main.tsx, PlaygroundNodes.ts, and layout.tsx as 'Do not change the file', indicating the agent modified files not required for code splitting.
review_details.performance_claim: Code splitting and tree shaking with lazy loading and granular Vite chunks, claiming reduced initial load and specific chunk sizes (e.g., vendor-react 11.84 kB, lexical 263.73 kB).
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer comments directed at unauthorized file changes; no explicit CHANGES_REQUESTED but clear rejection; PR auto-closed after >7 days inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent could implement code splitting but lacked awareness of which files were off-limits, leading to repeated scope violations and eventual closure; demonstrates a process boundary where agent changes must respect maintainer policy.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed diff and used inline comments to demand restoration of original files that were unnecessarily modified.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes chunk-size listing as evidence, but no before/after runtime metrics or profiler; Netlify preview showed Performance 0 (down 95 from production), indicating a regression not captured in the claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Two follow-up commits reverted changes to build script, postcss config, CSS import, and layout.tsx, but PR remained open and eventually auto-closed without further review resolution.

core_change_summary.description: Added React.lazy and Suspense wrappers for toolbar sub-components (FormatButtonGroup, HistoryButtonGroup, BlockFormatDropdown), editor plugins (MarkdownPlugin, ShortcutsPlugin), and export functionality; created LazyComponents.tsx, LazyPlugins.tsx, LazyExportFiles.tsx; updated ToolbarPlugin.tsx to use lazy imports; added sideEffects: false to package.json; configured Vite manual chunks for vendor-react, lexical, utils, ui, toolbar-components.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Several files (postcss.config.mjs, main.tsx, PlaygroundNodes.ts, layout.tsx) were changed unnecessarily and later reverted per review feedback; tsconfig changes remained but were not flagged.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (9f0587c): add lazy loading components, vite manual chunks, sideEffects, and modify multiple config/source files.
Review feedback: maintainer requested not to change postcss.config.mjs, main.tsx, PlaygroundNodes.ts.
Second commit (bd056bef): revert build script, postcss config, CSS import, and temporary CodeNode comment while keeping code splitting.
Additional review on layout.tsx SITE_CONFIG change.
Third commit (9d6a2f): revert layout.tsx import to original.

review_signals.summary: Requested to restore original postcss.config.mjs; 'Do not change the file'.
Requested to restore original main.tsx CSS import.
Requested to restore original PlaygroundNodes.ts CodeNode import.
Requested to restore original package.json build script.
Requested to restore original layout.tsx SITE_CONFIG import.
Two formal COMMENTED reviews with no body text; substantive feedback delivered via inline comments.
Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.
Netlify deployed preview; Lighthouse Performance 0, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 92.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.
